plan.summary: BRO-5527: shows on the NY tax-credit lists had no capitalization, so /biz had no cost basis for them. Each gets the total offering amount from its production entity's SEC Form D (Regulation D notice), matched to the show by the filing's related persons (lead producers), its timing and, where the tax-credit payout list names the entity, that name. Filed figures, not estimates; notes that said no capitalization was reported are corrected. Model rerun on apply. (part 4 of 6: patriots, spamalot, take-me-out-2022, the-cottage, the-hills-of-california-2024)
steps: Filed figures: capitalization, a Form D citation, the estimate flag, and the filing in sources.
Notes that said no capitalization was reported now state the filed offering.
